_note: Every module that rejects unknown input, and what verifies its accepted set. A checker that refuses a valid input is worse than one that misses an unknown key, so each needs evidence its table matches reality. `external` means a document outside this repo; `own examples` and `internal` are cross-checks against a second implementation rather than a rubber stamp.

wengold/fsl.py.what: the sixteen FSL commands and their arguments
wengold/fsl.py.source: Accellera Functional Safety Language Standard v1.0, Tables 3-33

wengold/cdc_standard.py.source: Accellera CDC/RDC Interface Standard v1.0, clause text and worked examples

wengold/generate/spec.py.what: the YAML spec keys, top level and nested
wengold/generate/spec.py.source: every examples/**/*.spec.yaml that ships, plus a perturbation probe: each accepted key's value is changed and the generated RTL must differ or the loader must reject it

wengold/desktop.py.source: CLI_COMMANDS against the `if verb ==` dispatch chain in the same module — two separate pieces of code, so they can drift
